summary: NATS module: NatsEventBus (cross-instance realtime, used by server/worker when messaging.enabled) and JetStream durable queue: producer with Nats-Msg-Id dedup + trace headers; durable pull consumer with bounded concurrency, progress acks, backoff retries, double acks; DLQ stream with reasons + replay; MAX_DELIVERIES sweeper for crash-on-last-attempt; graceful drain. Throughput benchmark vs PostgreSQL queue recorded (JetStream ~10x). Example-app runs stay on PostgreSQL by design (transactional enqueue, ADR 0007); an outbox relay is the documented path for transactional JetStream producers.
